versions.changelog:
- Initial release: fetch WeChat public article content using Playwright headed mode and real system browser.
- Extracts and saves article title, author, and body in both Markdown (.md) and HTML (.html) formats.
- Automatically bypasses WeChat anti-crawling by using a real browser window; does not require WeChat login.
- Supports Windows (Edge) and Linux (Firefox/Chromium); guides on necessary browser and dependency installation.
- Provides clear CLI workflow, file naming, and user feedback on saved files and article details.
- Requires GUI environment; headless mode triggers automatically for non-GUI servers.
